title: Prepare crystal structure input
action: Construct the Quantum ESPRESSO input file for δ-Ti (Cmcm) at 140 GPa using lattice parameters and atomic positions from the published literature (Akahama et al. or Vohra & Spencer).
description: Create the pw.x input file defining the Cmcm unit cell at 140 GPa with appropriate cutoff, k-point mesh, and pseudopotential.

title: SCF ground state calculation
action: Run pw.x to obtain the self-consistent charge density and wavefunctions for δ-Ti.
description: Perform a self-consistent field calculation with the GGA-PBE PAW pseudopotential. The output charge density is required for subsequent phonon calculations.

title: DFPT phonon calculation
action: Run ph.x on a q-point grid, followed by q2r.x and matdyn.x to obtain phonon frequencies and eigenvectors across the Brillouin zone.
description: Compute the dynamical matrix on a uniform q-mesh, then Fourier interpolate to obtain phonon dispersions and mode frequencies. Verify absence of imaginary modes to confirm stability.

title: Electron-phonon coupling calculation
action: Run lambda.x (or equivalent) using the phonon data to produce the Eliashberg spectral function α²F(ω) and cumulative EPC λ(ω).
description: Compute the phonon linewidths, the Eliashberg function, and the frequency-dependent EPC parameter λ(ω). Extract the total λ and logarithmic average frequency ω_log from the output.

title: Scored EPC and Tc results
action: From the λ(ω) data compute: (1) total λ = λ(∞); (2) ω_log from the α²F(ω) integration; (3) Tc via the McMillan-Allen-Dynes formula with μ*=0.19; (4) acoustic fraction = λ(120 cm⁻¹) / λ (contribution from modes ≤ 120 cm⁻¹). Write all four quantities to delta_Ti_140GPa_results.json.
description: Produce a JSON file with the four key quantities computed from the DFPT/EPC analysis: EPC constant λ, logarithmic average frequency ω_log, superconducting critical temperature Tc, and acoustic fraction.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: lambda (float), omega_log (float, in K), Tc (float, in K), acoustic_fraction (float, dimensionless).
